summary: 汉末黄巾起，刘关张桃园结义共举大义，从此仁主刘备身边聚拢了这道义与武。美髯长须的关羽温酒斩华雄、千里寻主，豹头环眼的张飞怒鞭督邮、长坂桥吼退曹军；武有常山赵子龙长坂坡单骑救主，智有卧龙诸葛亮隆中定策、羽扇纶巾定下三分，更有徐庶中途荐才、走马指路把人引向孔明。兄弟之义与知遇之恩，在这乱世里互相成全。

characters.name: 关羽
characters.oneLiner: 丹凤眼卧蚕眉、长髯二尺的义烈武圣，忠义二字重过天下。

persona.identity: 刘备结义二弟，汉末名将，善用青龙偃月刀
persona.appearance: 身长九尺，面如重枣，唇若涂脂，丹凤眼目光凛凛，卧蚕眉斜挑入鬓，一把美髯垂至胸前二尺（推断）。常年着一身绿锦战袍、内衬锁甲，跨马时以绛巾缠发，气度威而不怒、不怒自威，是全剧最令人敬畏又最重情义的那一张脸。
persona.temperament: 开口低沉稳重，声如洪钟，字字落地有声；敬兄长如奉君，对敌却一诺必践、言出刀随，极少废话。
persona.motivation: 追随玄德，义气为重；凡所许之诺，刀山火海也要周全。
persona.arc: 温酒斩华雄初显威名，过五关、斩六将千里寻主，虽有败走却始终义重于金；终在华容道违军令义释曹操，把忠义两个字升华为全剧的主题。

Subject: a scholarly modest Eastern Han dynasty Chinese strategist of late 3rd-century Central Plains China — clear bright eyes, fine clean brows, dignified bookish features, indigo-blue cloth scholar headwrap, simple faded blue-grey straight hemmed robe. LEFT ZONE (about 34% of canvas width): one bust portrait, head and shoulders, centered like an ID photo, front view, shoulders fully visible with clear empty space on both sides and a flat straight-cut bottom edge; render the face fully and finely as the facial baseline. RIGHT-TOP ZONE: three full-body views (front, side, back) side by side sharing one ground line, same figure, same outfit, same features as the bust. RIGHT-BOTTOM ZONE: a row of four to five small isolated close-up detail studies — the scholar headwrap knot, the clean brows, the robe sleeve cuff, the simple cloth sash, the worn hems. LIGHTING IN THE LEFT ZONE ONLY: soft directional key light from upper left with natural falloff, ambient occlusion along the jawline, eye sockets and collar; LIGHTING IN THE RIGHT ZONES: flat even orthographic lighting, no directional light, no shadows, for clean silhouettes and accurate proportions. PROPORTIONS ARE CRITICAL: all three full-body figures equal height, consistent head-to-body ratio, arms and legs correctly proportioned, feet aligned on the same ground line, headroom and footroom kept; no stretching, squashing or foreshortening; the detail studies give way, not the figures. The three-quarter face must match the bust portrait exactly — same features, same hairstyle, same expression.

voice.timbre: 清亮而带文气，青年书生的嗓子，略有一丝沙涩
voice.pace: 中速偏快，思虑多、语速随情绪起伏
voice.accent: 中原颍川一带北方口音，士子谈吐
voice.referenceHint: 像通晓兵法的寒士谋士，守着礼义，说急处时语气带着真切
voice.prompt: Early-thirties male, clear articulate tenor with a slight raspy edge, mid pitch register, light chest support, moderate dynamic range. Normal volume with eager quickening, brisk pace that hastens at urgent points, educated refined cadence. Central Plains (Yingchuan) regional accent, literate and honed. Earnest sincere and quietly anxious.
